I really like the concept of WatchiBeastie! It makes getting activities and movement intentional to grow and keep your Beastie alive, similar to a Tamagotchi. Which I was very excited about when I saw this was an app for my Garmin watch. 

To improve user experience, I would suggest that there be an option to customize some of the daily goals. For example, I prefer mediation over breath work. So I am not hitting my breath work goal that would contribute to points to my Beastie. If I could customize or choose between different activity options (say pick between breath work or meditation) this would be more achievable for my Beastie. 

My biggest pain point however is the fact that I've gotten 3 lizards back to back. And that 2 of those lizards were the same one. There should be coding to prevent a user to get the same Beastie over and over. By getting the same Beastie, it causes the user to disengage with the app. For example, my first lizard was green and my next was purple. I didn't mind getting the purple one as it was different from the first. However, my third Beastie is again, the green lizard. Which I'm just doing the base minimal to try and get to day 21 to try and get a new Beastie and I hope it is not a lizard. As a user I would understand if I had gone through all of the Beasties and then again get the green lizard as by that time I would have had other Beasties. But getting the same one over and over is boring. 

This app has a lot of potential and I really hope the developers make some of the user experience improvements suggested!
